notes.subject: to Egypt
notes.rationale: בתוככי is second-person feminine 'in your midst' — Egypt is directly addressed mid-sentence.

notes.subject: तोहर
notes.rationale: Hebrew's bound form בתוככי embeds the second-person pronoun; Magahi needs it as a separate word, marked with ⟨…⟩-convention in spirit though it is present in the Hebrew form.

notes.subject: फिनौन
notes.rationale: פרעה is a royal title, not a name; transliterated per name-rule.

translation: जे मिस्रयिम (मिस्र), तोहर भीतरे चिन्हा आउ अचरज के काम भेजलन — फिरौन के ऊपरे आउ ओकर सब नोकर के ऊपरे।
